surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Small libadwaita appearance panel opened from the header-bar Appearance button with app appearance controls and visual editor palette tiles.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: The compact controls remain vertically stacked, and the palette grid keeps stable visual choices without hiding palettes dynamically.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Centered dialog title for the Appearance panel, matching the typography and alignment used across the app's other dialogs.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: The title truncates naturally without displacing the close button.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Vertical scrolled container inside the appearance dialog so the palette tile grid remains reachable on short windows without resizing tiles.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: Vertical scrollbar appears automatically when the dialog content exceeds the available height, horizontal scrolling is disabled so palette rows always wrap by tile.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Single-page libadwaita preferences dialog with standard rows for word wrap, line numbers, current-line highlight, optional minimap, monospace editor font, staged indentation controls, autosave, and document format controls.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: Rows stay vertically stacked, SpinRows keep their numeric editor inline without horizontal scrolling, and the dialog remains usable at narrow widths without secondary pages.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Standard shortcuts window grouped into file, tab, search, view, project, and app actions (including Open Folder and Refresh Project Tree).
surfaces.collapse_behavior: Shortcut groups continue stacking in reading order as width tightens.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Single-window editor shell with a header bar, an overlay project sidebar for folder navigation, a runtime-inserted search bar above the tabs, per-tab banners for ongoing file state, optional minimaps inside tab content, a tabbed workspace, and a bottom status bar with document location, format, zoom, and cursor status.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: Header actions stay reachable while the project sidebar can be shown or hidden without displacing the editor, the search rows stack above the tabs, per-tab banners stay above editor content, the minimap remains a narrow fixed strip when enabled without taking over the layout, and the bottom status bar keeps the location, format, zoom, and cursor readouts reachable at narrow widths.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Centered window title reflects the selected tab title while the full file location lives in the bottom status bar.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: The title truncates naturally before it displaces primary header-bar actions.
